rows.text: In connection with the ratification of the Agreement on the creation of the Commonwealth of Independent States, the RSFSR Supreme Soviet recalls the RSFSR deputy groups from the Council of Republics and the Council of the Union of the USSR Supreme Soviet (point 1), invalidates its resolutions 1691-I of 27 September and 1765-I of 18 October 1991 on those groups (point 3), and puts the resolution into force from adoption (point 4); it is signed 'Председатель Верховного Совета РСФСР Р. И. ХАСБУЛАТОВ', 'Москва, Дом Советов РСФСР', 12 December 1991, 'N 2017-I'.
